For a test in (a)(i) you will need Tollens’ reagent. Place a 2–3cm depth of silver nitrate in a test-tube,
add aqueous sodium hydroxide drop by drop until a small amount of brown precipitate is formed
and then add aqueous ammonia drop by drop with shaking until the precipitate just dissolves. This
is Tollens’ reagent. When Tollens’ reagent is used, ensure that all test-tubes are thoroughly rinsed
immediately after use.
